name: Password Reset
description: Send a password reset link to the user.
html_content:
Reset your password

Hi {first_name},

We received a request to reset your password. Click the link below to choose a new one:

Reset my password

This link will expire in 30 minutes. If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email — your password won't change.

For your security, never share this email with anyone.

— {company_name} Security
